verdict.rationale: Morph documents an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint: you point any OpenAI SDK at its base URL, and existing OpenAI code only needs a new `model` string. It also serves the Anthropic Messages API natively, and an independent user got the OpenAI-compatible endpoint working with a third-party CLI. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of switching providers mid-workflow within a single agent session, and documentation of parity for tool calling and parameters across providers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent switch to or away from this provider mid-workflow because it speaks the standard chat-completions API without provider-specific code changes

citations.quote: Kimi K3 serves 1M context through the standard chat completions endpoint, so existing OpenAI code only needs a new `model` string
Point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1.
Claude Code speaks the Anthropic Messages API, which Morph serves natively at `/v1/messages`.
This uses an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so got this working with my llm.datasette.io CLI tool
